meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关键帧、节拍和配音合成成片，本地或云端一次性渲染发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做视频帧合成与渲染，想用命令行跑通从预览到发布的整套流程。
copy.tagline_en: Turn keyframes, beats, and voiceover into finished video, rendered locally or in the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build video frame pipelines and want one CLI from preview to publish

howto.what: 它让 Claude 用 npx hyperframes 命令做视频项目:新建项目、在本地目录搜现成动效、写合成、跑 lint 和 check 检查、开预览、按 draft/looks/delivery 三档渲染并核对输出文件,渲染前先等你确认。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建、预览或渲染 HyperFrames 项目,提到 catalog、check、render 等命令,或排查构建与渲染失败时触发。

howto.what_en: It makes Claude drive the HyperFrames CLI loop: scaffold a project, search the local catalog for existing motion, author compositions, run lint and check, open a preview, then render at draft/looks/delivery quality and verify the output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to scaffold, preview or render a HyperFrames project, mention commands like catalog, check or render, or diagnose build and render failures.
